CreateLocalRecordDownloadByTimeJob.summary: Invoke this API to create a job for downloading local recordings by time range.
CreateLocalRecordDownloadByTimeJob.description:
## Limits

- Maximum duration for a single time-based download: 30 minutes.
- Download jobs and files are retained for up to 1 day. You can re-initiate the download after expiration.
- A single instance supports a maximum concurrency limit of 10 ingest endpoints for downloads (completed downloads are not counted).
- If audio or video encoding parameters change during recording, the downloaded file by default corresponds to the first segment of the recording.
- Due to network fluctuations on the device's upstream link, connection disruptions or intentional data discarding by the device may occur, potentially resulting in incomplete uploaded or downloaded recording files.
- The downloaded recording data depends on the device’s stream ingest logic. If the ingested streaming data is abnormal, the actual duration of the downloaded recording may differ from the time range specified in the job.

## Queries Per Second (QPS) Limit

A single Alibaba Cloud account can make a maximum of 50 queries per second (QPS) to this API.

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the same quota as the Alibaba Cloud account.

    ```

    ```
    http(s)://linkvisual.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/?Action=CreateTimeTemplate

TransferDeviceInstance.title: TransferDeviceInstance
TransferDeviceInstance.summary: Migrate the instance where the device is located.
TransferDeviceInstance.description:
Before invoking this API to migrate the instance where a device is located, contact Tech Support to evaluate the migration plan and prevent loss of functionality after migration.

**Prerequisites**

- The device to be migrated has the Video service feature enabled.
    - For devices in a public instance: Log on to the IoT Platform console and click **Public Instance**. In the left-side menu bar, choose **Video Service** > **Access Service**. On the **Access Service** page, click the **Product Management** tab. Confirm that the product to which the device to be migrated belongs shows **Enabled** in the **Enabled/Disabled Status** column.
    - For devices in an Enterprise instance: The Video service has already been enabled.
- The device distribution job has been completed. For more information, see [CreateDeviceDistributeJob](~~199390~~) or [Device Distribution](~~143450~~).
- Ensure that the camera device has a picture lifecycle configured. If no picture lifecycle is configured for the camera device, invoking this API automatically sets the picture lifecycle to 180 days. For more information, see [SetDevicePictureLifeCycle](~~107880~~).

**Background information**
- If the source instance and target instance types differ, understand their metering methods before migration. For details, see [Billing overview](~~124250~~).
- During migration, devices go offline. The more devices involved, the longer the migration takes. Data generated by devices during this period cannot be retained.
